ai_analysis.summary: An EY-branded interview question bank for data engineer candidates with 3–4 years of experience. It groups prompts into SQL and data manipulation, Python, PySpark and Spark, Azure data engineering, data modeling and warehousing, and production or behavioral topics. The supplied content contains questions only, without answers, definitions, SQL code, examples, or implementation details, and ends with “see more,” indicating that the displayed post may be incomplete.
